newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CBA lowers personal loan, credit card rates.
newsitem.headline: CBA lowers personal loan, credit card rates.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Thursday it had cut interest rates on business and personal credit cards, as well as rates on personal loans, following Wednesday's 50 basis point official interest rate cut.
The CBA said the personal loan rate for new and existing borrowers would be 12.70 percent, down from a previous 14.10 percent, effective from August 1.

The interest rate on credit cards with no interest free period has been lowered to 13.95 percent from 14.60 percent previously. For credit cards with up to a 55 day interest free period, the rate falls to 15.10 percent from 15.60 percent.
The new credit card rates are effective from August 8.
The CBA also lowered the rate on the capital business card to 12.00 percent from 12.50 percent, effective from September 1.
